callees.name: is_cli_backend_enabled
callees.post_condition: Returns True when the configured LLM backend is a CLI-based backend (codex-cli or claude-cli); returns False otherwise.

callees.name: run_agent_for_messages
callees.pre_condition: model is a non-empty string naming the LLM model. messages is a non-empty list of message dicts with 'role' and 'content' keys.
callees.post_condition: Returns a 2-tuple (text_response, usage_dict) where text_response is the string LLM output and usage_dict is a dict with token usage information. Raises an exception on persistent failure.

callees.name: _is_anthropic_model
callees.post_condition: Returns True when model identifies an Anthropic-family model (by name prefix); returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _should_inject_user_id
callees.pre_condition: base_url is a string (may be empty) representing the LLM API base URL.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when the base_url matches a configured host pattern that supports user-ID-based prompt-cache routing affinity; returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _metadata_body
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict containing metadata fields (including user_id) suitable for injection into the API request body.

callees.name: _anthropic_create
callees.pre_condition: model is a non-empty string identifying the Anthropic model. messages is a non-empty list of message dicts with 'role' and 'content' keys.
callees.post_condition: Returns a 2-tuple (text, usage) where text is the string LLM response content and usage is a dict with token usage metadata. Raises an exception on API communication failure.

callees.name: _read_error_body
callees.post_condition: Returns the raw response body string from the HTTP error when readable; returns None when the body cannot be read.
